materials.Name: Spirit of Nitre (Nitric Acid)
materials.Description: A clear, colourless liquid with a very sharp, acrid scent
materials.Effects: As an action, you can splash the contents of this vial onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw the vial up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. In either case, make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the acid as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 damage.[p] If imbibed, acids deal twice the normal damage, and if the target is a living creature it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1d4 hours.
materials.IdentifySays: [i]Potion Type:[/i] Alchemist[br][i]Essence(s)[/i]: Fire, Water[br][i]Spell:[/i] none detected
